items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: Joe Williams came along -- which is a good -- you know -- second coming in after Jimmy Rushing.

ctx.x: -- Which -- you know -- he did his thing, right? He was it -- you know -- you looked for him. He did a terrific job when he was there. Joe Williams came along -- which is a good -- you know -- second coming in after Jimmy Rushing. And, the people, you know, took to him right away. So, anybody else that come in and don't come up to this -- you know -- how it is.
Right. I think that it's important because the band might have had a hard time in the '50's without him. Because things weren't good were they?
